fat_pct.quote: freshmade Garrotxa cheese (42.2% moisture, 2.8% ash, 37.1% fat, and 18.2% protein).

salt_pct.quote: Core 0.69 g NaCl/100 g, Rind 1.10 g NaCl/100 g – control; Core 0.80 g NaCl/100 g, Rind 1.00 g NaCl/100 g – HHP

ammonia.reason: Limited NH3 from amino-acid deamination during short 8-week pressed ripening.

animal_barnyard.reason: Trace p-cresol/indole from Tyr/Trp catabolism plus goat-milk carryover.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin proteolysis partly trimmed by starter peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: Low 2-heptanone/2-nonanone via surface Penicillium beta-oxidation of free fatty acids.

browning.reason: Limited Maillard between residual lactose/galactose and lysine on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from Lactococcus citrate metabolism in young uncooked curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic/isovaleric acids from lipoprotein lipase and starter esterase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: High 57% fat-in-dry-matter and small goat fat globules lubricate mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Mixed rennet-acid gel at pH 5.0 demineralized, giving short friable pressed body.

firmness.reason: Pressed uncooked paracasein network with calcium-phosphate crosslinks at pH 5.0.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from microbial esterase esterification of FFA with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Hexanoic/octanoic/decanoic plus 4-methyloctanoic from goat triglyceride lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal from Leu/Val Strecker degradation during 2-mo aging.

melt.reason: pH 5.0 intact casein network softens and flows moderately when heated.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid lipoxygenase activity of natural grey-mold rind.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from coalesced high-fat goat milk fat on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, therefore no guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: L-lactic plus trace acetic acid from starter fermentation to pH 5.0.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading, casein fibers do not align.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Uncooked curd with minimal methionine catabolism to H2S/methional.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/lactate plus lactones masking acidity in young paste.

umami.reason: Free glutamate released by chymosin and starter peptidase proteolysis.
